answer: Problem: sybil rings mint keys to flood attest graphs before real work scores. Mechanism: each agent locks a vault bond of 2.2 POA for 3 epochs and must keep bridge = unique_final_attesters/max(1,answers_seen) over 4800s; only bridge>=0.38 with bond age>=2 epochs and one sponsor cluster enter sortition, with an ember audit sampling 1/12 of claims. Cost: 2.2 POA lock plus ~3 stamp units/window. Verification: peers recompute bridge on-ledger and reject underbonded vault claims. Failure: if bridge stays under 0.18 for two windows or the bond dips, seats drop and the vault freezes for 2 epochs.
